Haa Meem
Yeh Khuda-e-Azeez o Aleem ki taraf se naazil ki hui kitaab hai
Woh gunaahon ka bakhshne waala, tauba ka qubool karne waala, shadeed azaab karne waala aur saahib-e-fazl o karam hai. Us ke ilaawa doosra khuda nahin hai aur sab ki baazgasht usi ki taraf hai
Allah ki nishaaniyon mein sirf woh jhagda karte hain jo kaafir ho gaye hain, lihaaza un ka mukhtalif shehron mein chakkar lagaana tumhein dhoke mein na daal de

In se pehle bhi Nooh alaihis-salaam ki qaum aur us ke baad waale girohon ne rasoolon ki takzeeb ki hai, aur har ummat ne apne rasool ke baare mein yeh iraada kiya hai ke use giraftaar kar lein, aur baatil ka sahaara le kar jhagda kiya hai ke haq ko ukhaad kar phenk dein. To hum ne bhi inhein apni giraft mein le liya, to tum ne dekha ke hamaara azaab kaisa tha
Aur isi tarah tumhaare Parwardigar ka azaab kaafiron par saabit ho chuka hai ke woh Jahannam mein jaane waale hain

Jo farishte Arsh-e-Ilaahi ko uthaaye hue hain aur jo us ke gird mu'ayyan hain sab hamd-e-Khuda ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain aur usi par imaan rakhte hain, aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye istighfaar kar rahe hain ke Khudaaya! Teri rehmat aur tera ilm har shai par muheet hai, lihaaza un logon ko bakhsh de jinhon ne tauba ki hai aur tere raaste ka ittibaa' kiya hai, aur inhein Jahannam ke azaab se bacha le

Parwardigar! Inhein aur un ke baap daada, azwaaj aur aulaad mein se jo nek aur saaleh afraad hain un ko hamesha rehne waale baaghaat mein daakhil farma jin ka tu ne un se waada kiya hai, ke beshak tu sab par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Aur inhein buraaiyon se mahfooz farma, ke aaj jin logon ko tu ne buraaiyon se bacha liya goya unhi par rahm kiya hai, aur yeh bahut badi kaamyaabi hai

Beshak jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un se roz-e-qiyaamat pukaar kar kaha jaaega ke tum khud jis qadar apni jaan se bezaar ho, Khuda ki naaraazgi us se kahin zyaada badi hai, ke tum ko imaan ki taraf daawat di jaati thi aur tum kufr ikhtiyaar kar lete the
Woh log kahenge: Parwardigar! Tu ne humein do martaba maut di aur do martaba zindagi ata ki, to ab hum ne apne gunaahon ka iqraar kar liya hai, to kya is se bach nikalne ki koi sabeel hai

Yeh sab is liye hai ke jab Khuda-e-Waahid ka naam liya gaya to tum logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya, aur jab shirk ki baat ki gayi to tum ne fauran maan liya, to ab faisla sirf Khuda-e-Buland o Buzurg ke haath mein hai
Wahi woh hai jo tumhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhlaata hai aur tumhaare liye aasmaan se rizq naazil karta hai, aur us se wahi naseehat haasil karta hai jo us ki taraf rujoo karta hai
Lihaaza tum khaalis ibaadat ke saath Khuda ko pukaaro chaahe kaafireen ko yeh kitna hi naagawaar kyon na ho
Woh Khuda buland darajaat ka maalik aur Saahib-e-Arsh hai. Woh apne bandon mein se jis par chaahta hai apne hukm se wahi ko naazil karta hai taake mulaaqaat ke din se logon ko daraaye
Jis din sab nikal kar saamne aa jaayenge aur Khuda par koi baat makhfi nahin reh jaaegi. Aaj kis ka mulk hai? Bas Khuda-e-Waahid o Qahhaar ka mulk hai
Aaj har nafs ko us ke kiye ka badla diya jaaega aur aaj kisi tarah ka zulm na ho sakega, beshak Allah bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai

Aur Paighambar! Inhein aane waale din ke azaab se daraaiye jab dam ghut ghut kar dil munh ke qareeb aa jaayenge, aur zaalimeen ke liye na koi dost hoga aur na sifaarish karne waala jis ki baat sun li jaaye
Woh Khuda nigaahon ki khiyaanat ko bhi jaanta hai aur dilon ke chhupe hue bhedon se bhi baakhabar hai
Woh haq ke saath faisla karta hai, aur us ko chhod kar yeh jin ki ibaadat karte hain woh to koi faisla bhi nahin kar sakte hain. Beshak Allah sab ki sunne waala aur sab kuch dekhne waala hai

Kya un logon ne zameen mein sair nahin ki ke dekhte ke un se pehle waalon ka anjaam kya hua hai, jo un se zyaada zabardast quwwat rakhne waale the aur zameen mein aasaar ke maalik the. Phir Khuda ne inhein un ke gunaahon ki giraft mein le liya aur Allah ke muqaable mein un ka koi bachaane waala nahin tha

Yeh sab is liye hua ke un ke paas rasool khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aate the to unhon ne inkaar kar diya, to phir Khuda ne bhi inhein apni giraft mein le liya, ke woh bahut quwwat waala aur sakht azaab karne waala hai
Aur hum ne Moosa alaihis-salaam ko apni nishaaniyon aur raushan daleel ke saath bheja hai
Fir'aun, Haamaan aur Qaaroon ki taraf, to un sab ne keh diya ke yeh jaadoogar aur jhoote hain

To phir us ke baad jab woh hamaari taraf se haq le kar aaye to un logon ne keh diya ke jo un par imaan le aayein un ke ladkon ko qatl kar do aur ladkiyon ko zinda rakho, aur kaafiron ka makr bahar-haal bhatak jaane waala hota hai

Aur Fir'aun ne kaha ke zara mujhe chhod do main Moosa alaihis-salaam ka khaatma kar doon, aur yeh apne Rab ko pukaarein. Mujhe khauf hai ke kahin yeh tumhaare deen ko badal na dein aur zameen mein koi fasaad na barpa kar dein
Aur Moosa alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke main apne aur tumhaare Parwardigar ki panaah haasil kar raha hoon har us mutakabbir ke muqaable mein jis ka roz-e-hisaab par imaan nahin hai

Aur Fir'aun waalon mein se ek mard-e-momin ne jo apne imaan ko chhupaaye hue tha yeh kaha ke kya tum log kisi shakhs ko sirf is baat par qatl kar rahe ho ke woh kehta hai ke mera Parwardigar Allah hai, aur woh tumhaare Rab ki taraf se khuli hui daleelein bhi le kar aaya hai? Aur agar jhoota hai to us ke jhooth ka azaab us ke sar hoga, aur agar sachcha nikal aaya to jin baaton se dara raha hai woh museebatein tum par naazil bhi ho sakti hain. Beshak Allah kisi zyaadati karne waale aur jhoote ki rehnumaai nahin karta hai

Meri qaum waalo! Beshak aaj tumhaare paas hukoomat hai aur zameen par tumhaara ghalaba hai, lekin agar azaab-e-Khuda aa gaya to humein us se kaun bachaaega? Fir'aun ne kaha ke main tumhein wahi baatein bata raha hoon jo main khud samajh raha hoon, aur main tumhein aqlmandi ke raaste ke ilaawa aur kisi raah ki hidaayat nahin kar raha hoon
Aur imaan laane waale shakhs ne kaha ke aye qaum! Main tumhaare baare mein us din jaise azaab ka khatra mehsoos kar raha hoon jo doosri qaumon ke azaab ka din tha
Qaum-e-Nooh, qaum-e-Aad, qaum-e-Samood aur un ke baad waalon jaisa haal, aur Allah yaqeenan apne bandon par zulm karna nahin chaahta hai
Aur aye qaum! Main tumhaare baare mein baahami faryaad ke din se dar raha hoon
Jis din tum sab peeth pher kar bhaagoge aur Allah ke muqaable mein koi tumhaara bachaane waala na hoga, aur jis ko Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de us ka koi hidaayat karne waala nahin hai

Aur is se pehle Yusuf alaihis-salaam bhi tumhaare paas aaye the to bhi tum un ke paighaam ke baare mein shak hi mein mubtala rahe, yahaan tak ke jab woh duniya se chale gaye to tum ne yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke Khuda us ke baad koi rasool nahin bhejega. Isi tarah Khuda zyaadati karne waale aur shakki-mizaaj insaanon ko un ki gumraahi mein chhod deta hai

Jo log ke aayaat-e-Ilaahi mein behas karte hain baghair is ke ke un ke paas Khuda ki taraf se koi daleel aaye, woh Allah aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke nazdeek sakht nafrat ke haqdaar hain, aur Allah isi tarah har maghroor aur sarkash insaan ke dil par mohr laga deta hai
Aur Fir'aun ne kaha ke Haamaan! Mere liye ek qila tayyaar kar ke main us ke asbaab tak pahunch jaaoon

Jo ke aasmaan ke raaste hain, aur is tarah Moosa alaihis-salaam ke Khuda ko dekh loon, aur mera to khayaal yeh hai ke Moosa alaihis-salaam jhoote hain aur koi khuda nahin hai. Aur isi tarah Fir'aun ke liye us ki bad-amali ko aaraasta kar diya gaya aur use raaste se rok diya gaya, aur Fir'aun ki chaalon ka anjaam siwaaye halaakat aur tabaahi ke kuch nahin hai
Aur jo shakhs imaan le aaya tha us ne kaha ke aye qaum waalo! Mera ittibaa' karo to main tumhein hidaayat ka raasta dikha sakta hoon
Qaum waalo! Yaad rakho ke yeh hayaat-e-duniya sirf chand-roza lazzat hai, aur hamesha rehne ka ghar sirf aakhirat ka ghar hai

Jo bhi koi buraai karega use waisa hi badla diya jaaega, aur jo nek amal karega chaahe woh mard ho ya aurat, ba-shart-e-ke saahib-e-imaan bhi ho, inhein Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaaega aur wahaan be-hisaab rizq diya jaaega
Aur aye qaum waalo! Aakhir tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke main tumhein najaat ki daawat de raha hoon aur tum mujhe Jahannam ki taraf daawat de rahe ho

Tumhaari daawat yeh hai ke main Khuda ka inkaar kar doon aur unhein us ka shareek bana doon jin ka koi ilm nahin hai, aur main tum ko us Khuda ki taraf daawat de raha hoon jo saahib-e-izzat aur bahut zyaada bakhshne waala hai

Beshak jis ki taraf tum daawat de rahe ho woh na duniya mein pukaarne ke qaabil hai aur na aakhirat mein, aur hum sab ki baazgasht bil-aakhir Allah hi ki taraf hai, aur zyaadati karne waale hi dar-asal Jahannam waale hain
Phir anqareeb tum use yaad karoge jo main tum se keh raha hoon, aur main to apne mu'aamlaat ko Parwardigar ke hawaale kar raha hoon, ke beshak woh tamaam bandon ke haalaat ka khoob dekhne waala hai
To Allah ne us mard-e-momin ko un logon ki chaalon ke nuqsaanaat se bacha liya, aur Fir'aun waalon ko badtareen azaab ne gher liya
Woh Jahannam jis ke saamne yeh har subah o shaam pesh kiye jaate hain, aur jab qiyaamat barpa hogi to farishton ko hukm hoga ke Fir'aun waalon ko badtareen azaab ki manzil mein daakhil kar do

Aur us waqt ko yaad dilaao jab yeh sab Jahannam ke andar jhagde karenge, aur kamzor log mustakbir logon se kahenge ke hum tumhaari pairwi karne waale the, to kya tum Jahannam ke kuch hisse se bhi humein bacha sakte ho aur hamaare kaam aa sakte ho
To istikbaar karne waale kahenge ke ab hum sab ki manzil yahi hai, ke Allah bandon ke darmiyaan faisla kar chuka hai
Us ke baad Jahannam mein rehne waale Jahannam ke khaazinon se kahenge ke apne Parwardigar se dua karo ke ek hi din hamaare azaab mein takhfeef kar de

Woh jawaab denge ke kya tumhaare paas tumhaare rasool khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar nahin aaye the? Woh log kahenge ke beshak aaye the. To jawaab milega phir tum khud hi aawaaz do, haalaanke kaafiron ki aawaaz aur faryaad bekaar hi saabit hogi
Beshak hum apne rasool aur imaan laane waalon ki zindagaani-e-duniya mein bhi madad karte hain aur us din bhi madad karenge jab saare gawaah uth khade honge
Jis din zaalimeen ke liye koi ma'zarat kaargar na hogi, aur un ke liye la'nat aur badtareen ghar hoga
Aur yaqeenan hum ne Moosa alaihis-salaam ko hidaayat ata ki aur Bani Israaeel ko kitaab ka waaris banaaya hai
Jo kitaab mujassama-e-hidaayat aur saahibaan-e-aql ke liye naseehat ka saamaan thi
Lihaaza aap sabr karein ke Allah ka waada yaqeenan barhaq hai, aur apne haq mein istighfaar karte rahein aur subah o shaam apne Parwardigar ki hamd ki tasbeeh karte rahein

Beshak jo log Khuda ki taraf se aane waali daleel ke baghair Khuda ki nishaaniyon mein behas karte hain un ke dilon mein badaai ke khayaal ke ilaawa aur kuch nahin hai, aur woh us tak pahunch bhi nahin sakte hain. Lihaaza aap Khuda ki panaah talab karein ke wahi sab ki sunne waala aur sab ke haalaat ka dekhne waala hai
Beshak zameen o aasmaan ka paida kar dena logon ke paida kar dene se kahin zyaada bada kaam hai, lekin logon ki aksariyat yeh bhi nahin jaanti hai

Aur yaad rakho ke andhe aur beena baraabar nahin ho sakte hain, aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain woh bhi badkaaron jaise nahin ho sakte hain, magar tum log bahut kam naseehat haasil karte ho
Beshak qiyaamat aane waali hai aur us mein kisi shak ki gunjaaish nahin hai, lekin logon ki aksariyat is baat par imaan nahin rakhti hai
Aur tumhaare Parwardigar ka irshaad hai ke mujh se dua karo main qubool karoonga, aur yaqeenan jo log meri ibaadat se akadte hain woh anqareeb zillat ke saath Jahannam mein daakhil honge

Allah hi woh hai jis ne tumhaare liye raat ko paida kiya hai taake tum us mein sukoon haasil kar sako, aur din ko raushni ka zariya qaraar diya hai. Beshak woh apne bandon par bahut zyaada fazl o karam karne waala hai, lekin logon ki aksariyat us ka shukriya ada nahin karti hai
Wahi tumhaara Parwardigar hai jo har shai ka khaaliq hai aur us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, to tum kidhar behke ja rahe ho
Isi tarah woh log behkaaye jaate hain jo Allah ki nishaaniyon ka inkaar kar dete hain

Allah hi woh hai jis ne tumhaare liye zameen ko mustaqar aur aasmaan ko imaarat qaraar diya hai, aur tumhaari soorat ko behtareen soorat banaaya hai aur tumhein paakeeza rizq ata kiya hai. Wahi tumhaara Parwardigar hai, to aalameen ka paalne waala kis qadar barakaton ka maalik hai
Woh hamesha zinda rehne waala hai, us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, lihaaza tum log ikhlaas-e-deen ke saath us ki ibaadat karo ke saari taareef usi aalameen ke paalne waale Khuda ke liye hai

Aap keh dijiye ke mujhe is baat se mana kiya gaya hai ke main un ki ibaadat karoon jinhein tum Khuda ko chhod kar parastish ke qaabil banaaye hue ho, jab ke mere paas khuli hui nishaaniyaan aa chuki hain, aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka itaa'at-guzaar banda rahoon

Wahi Khuda hai jis ne tum ko mitti se paida kiya, phir nutfe se, phir jame hue khoon se, phir tum ko bachcha bana kar baahar laata hai, phir zinda rakhta hai ke tawaanaaiyon ko pahuncho, phir boodhe ho jaao, aur tum mein se ba'z ko pehle hi utha liya jaata hai, aur tum ko is liye zinda rakhta hai ke apni muqarrara muddat ko pahunch jaao, aur shaayad tumhein aql bhi aa jaaye
Wahi woh hai jo hayaat bhi deta hai aur maut bhi deta hai. Phir jab kisi baat ka faisla kar leta hai to us se kehta hai ke ho ja aur woh ho jaati hai
Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha hai jo aayaat-e-Ilaahi ke baare mein jhagda karte hain, aakhir yeh kahaan bhatakte chale ja rahe hain
Jin logon ne kitaab aur un baaton ki takzeeb ki jin ko de kar hum ne paighambaron ko bheja tha, inhein anqareeb us ka anjaam maaloom ho jaaega
Jab un ki gardanon mein tauq aur zanjeerein daali jaayengi aur inhein kheencha jaaega
Garm paani mein, aur us ke baad Jahannam mein jhonk diya jaaega
Phir yeh kaha jaaega ke ab woh kahaan hain jinhein tum shareek banaaya karte the
Khuda ko chhod kar? To woh log jawaab denge ke woh hum ko chhod kar gum ho gaye, balke hum is ke pehle kisi ko nahin pukaara karte the. Aur Allah isi tarah kaafiron ko gumraahi mein chhod deta hai
Yeh sab is baat ka nateeja hai ke tum log zameen mein baatil se khush hua karte the aur akad kar chala karte the
Ab Jahannam ke darwaazon se daakhil ho jaao aur usi mein hamesha raho, ke akadne waalon ka thikaana bahut bura hai

Ab aap sabr karein ke Khuda ka waada bilkul sachcha hai. Phir ya to hum jin baaton ki dhamki de rahe hain un mein se kuch aap ko dikhla denge, ya aap ko pehle hi utha lenge, to bhi woh sab palta kar yahin laaye jaayenge

Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi bahut se rasool bheje hain jin mein se ba'z ka tazkira aap se kiya hai aur ba'z ka tazkira bhi nahin kiya hai, aur kisi rasool ke imkaan mein yeh baat nahin hai ke Khuda ki ijaazat ke baghair koi mo'jiza le aaye. Phir jab hukm-e-Khuda aa gaya to haq ke saath faisla kar diya gaya, aur us waqt ahl-e-baatil hi khasaare mein rahe
Allah hi woh hai jis ne chaupaayon ko tumhaare liye khalq kiya hai, jin mein se ba'z par tum sawaari karte ho aur ba'z ko khaane mein istemaal karte ho
Aur tumhaare liye un mein bahut se manaafe hain, aur is liye bhi ke tum un ke zariye apni dili muraadon tak pahunch sako, aur tumhein un jaanwaron par aur kashtiyon par sawaar kiya jaata hai
Aur Khuda tumhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhlaata hai, to tum us ki kis kis nishaani se inkaar karoge

Kya un logon ne zameen mein sair nahin ki hai ke dekhte ke un se pehle waalon ka anjaam kya hua hai, jo un ke muqaable mein aksariyat mein the aur zyaada taaqatwar bhi the aur zameen mein aasaar ke maalik the, lekin jo kuch bhi kamaaya tha kuch kaam na aaya aur mubtala-e-azaab ho gaye
Phir jab un ke paas rasool mo'jizaat le kar aaye to apne ilm ki bina par naaz karne lage, aur nateeje mein jis baat ka mazaaq uda rahe the usi ne inhein apne ghere mein le liya
Phir jab unhon ne hamaare azaab ko dekha to kehne lage ke hum Khuda-e-Yakta par imaan laaye hain aur jin baaton ka shirk kiya karte the sab ka inkaar kar rahe hain

To azaab ke dekhne ke baad koi imaan kaam aane waala nahin tha, ke yeh Allah ka mustaqil tareeqa hai jo us ke bandon ke baare mein guzar chuka hai, aur usi waqt kaafir khasaare mein mubtala ho jaate hain
